description: This file defines multiple enum classes representing various constants and command names used within the OpenClaw application protocol, such as capabilities and command types for different device functionalities.

classes.name: OpenClawCapability
classes.description: Enumeration of device capabilities that can be accessed or utilized.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasCommand
classes.description: Enumeration of commands related to canvas manipulation.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UICommand
classes.description: Enumeration of commands for canvas A2UI interactions.

classes.name: OpenClawSmsCommand
classes.description: Enumeration of SMS commands for sending and searching messages.

classes.name: OpenClawDeviceCommand
classes.description: Enumeration of device status and information commands.

classes.name: OpenClawSystemCommand
classes.description: Enumeration of system commands such as notifications.

classes.name: OpenClawMotionCommand
classes.description: Enumeration for motion activity and pedometer commands.

classes.name: OpenClawCallLogCommand
classes.description: Enumeration for call log search commands.
